main_text.p: פַּנְדִּירָא C. Nomen proprium viri, Esth. 7.10. in T. sec.
פַּנְטִירִי פִּנָּט Ch. Jaspis, lapis pretiosus. Scribitur etiam cum ת. Idem forte cum אַפִּנְטוֹר.
ܦܢܛܩܣܛܝ Syr. Pentecoste, Festum Pentecostes, Act. 2.1. & cum ܠ in medio, 1.ad Cor. 16.8.
פְּנַךְ Pahel Ch. Salire, saltare, subsilire, fremere, plaudere. Verbum equorum proprium.
ܦܢܘܦܐ Syr. Paropsis, Scutella, Græc. παυαχὶς, παυάχιον.
פַּנֵּק Chald. Delicatè habere vel nutrire. Ithpahel אִתְפַּנַּק Deliciari, In deliciis esse, Delicias agere, Oblectare se.
מְפַנַּק Ch. Tener, Delicatus. Fœm. מְפַנְּקְתָּא, מְפַנְּקָא.
פִּנְקָס Ch. Tabula, tabella, pugillares, codicilli: Item Atramentarium, Græc. πινάκις, πινακίδιον. Plur. constr.
פִּנְקֵסֵי חוֹשְׁבָּנִיָּה Tabulas rationis suae, Genes. 39. 11. in Jonathane.
פַּנְתִּירִין Ch. Pantherius, Jaspis, lapis pretiosus. Idem quod supra פַּנְטִירִי.

page.notes: The Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are reproduced from a small, faded scan and several vowel points and diacritics are uncertain; Syriac lines are approximate. The page is otherwise clearly legible. Printed errors and cross-reference abbreviations left as printed.
